claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationMechanics.usageLimit
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: At level 17 the SRD explicitly limits Action Surge to once per turn even though two uses are available per rest. ClassFeatureActivationMechanics has no perTurnLimit / usageLimit field; only MasteryMechanics has one (MasteryUsageLimit = {kind: 'once_per_turn'}). A parallel optional field on ClassFeatureActivationMechanics would let the tracer emit a use_count fence + turn_start_window for the per-turn cap, keeping it consistent with the mastery subgraph pattern.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Starting at level 17, you can use it twice before a rest but only once on a turn.
